author: Michael Larabel
description: With the end of the month comes a new monthly status report from the KDE Linux project as their in-house distribution project...
title: KDE Linux Now Providing Automatic Btrfs Snapshots For All User Files

author: Michael Larabel
description: Hitting the Linux kernel mailing list today is a new kernel scheduler patch series to enable preferred SMT siblings for NVIDIA Vera with its Olympus cores...
title: NVIDIA Posts Linux Scheduler Patches To Further Boost SMT Performance On NVIDIA Vera

author: Michael Larabel
description: Rust Coreutils 0.11 was just released as this alternative to the GNU Coreutils. Besides the long-running task of catching up the GNU Coreutils compatibility with the GNU test suite and never-ending work on optimizing the performance, Rust Coreutils 0.11 is quite a nice release for its improved error messages...
title: Rust Coreutils 0.11 Released With Some Nifty Debug Helper Messages

author: Michael Larabel
description: The Mozilla Firefox 155 release binaries are now available ahead of the formal announcement on Tuesday for this latest web browser release. With Firefox 155 it's heavier on new features than we have seen in some time...
title: Firefox 155 Available With Faster Page Loads Via Happy Eyeballs v3, QUIC v2 For HTTP/3

author: Michael Larabel
description: One of the former Intel engineers who was a Linux OS architect on their legendary Clear Linux distribution and before that also driving their Moblin and MeeGo Linux efforts is starting a new distribution project. This new initiative, named The Ur Project, is highly leveraging Rust and will rely on AI/LLMs in part and aims to incorporate some deisng improvements Clear Linux...
title: Former Intel Engineer Who Was One Of The Clear Linux Architects Is Starting A New Distro

author: Michael Larabel
description: Open-source firmware consulting firm 3mdeb is out with a new blog post highlighting their recent work on enhancing the UEFI update capsules experience for open-source firmware with Coreboot and their downstream Dasharo offerings...
title: 3mdeb Enhancing The UEFI Update Capsules Experience For Open-Source Firmware

author: Michael Larabel
description: With Linux 7.3-rc1 released to cap off the two week merge window, here is a look at the many exciting changes merged for the Linux 7.3 kernel that is working its way toward release in the second half of October.
title: Linux 7.3 Features Many Exciting Improvements, New Hardware Support & Faster Btrfs

author: Michael Larabel
description: There is a set of 19 patches out for review on the Linux kernel mailing list that would finally allow the mainline kernel running on Apple Silicon M1 / M2 / M3 SoCs to enjoy USB4/Thunderbolt support...
title: Linux Kernel Patches Out For Review To Enable USB4/Thunderbolt For Apple M1 / M2 / M3

author: Michael Larabel
description: Servo 0.5 is out today as the newest monthly update to this open-source, Rust-based browser engine. Servo 0.5 ships many notable enhancements for benefiting those running the Servoshell example browser or looking at Servo as an opportunity for embedded use...
title: Servo 0.5 Released: DuckDuckGo Properly Rendering, Up To 10x Faster Text Rendering

author: Michael Larabel
description: Firefox has finally begun supporting Vulkan Video decoding to complement their long-used VA-API support on Linux. This is good news for the official NVIDIA Linux graphics driver stack as it's been the notable vendor not supporting the Video Acceleration API. But prior to Firefox rolling out its experimental Vulkan Video support, an independent implementation of VA-API built atop NVIDIA's NVDEC interface has been available for supporting GPU video acceleration in Firefox. That project is out today with its newest release...
title: NVIDIA VA-API Driver 0.0.18 Ships More Fixes, Chrome/Chromium Decode On Direct Backend
